subject: project:gdl
value: RETRIEVAL PILOT, 4 OF THE FROZEN 24, SCORED HONESTLY: 1 HIT, 1 PARTIAL, 2 MISS. Method: each function was rewound to its manifest pre state, its residual signature captured verbatim from `fndiff --ops`, and the three queries an agent would actually run (`context <fn>`, `brief <tu>`, `laws --residual <signature>`) were run against the live graph. Ground truth is the mechanism the historical matching commit ACTUALLY used, read from its diff. A hit requires a surfaced item to name that mechanism, not merely its family, and is disallowed when the item is anchored to the function under test and dated on/after its match commit. ROWS. (1) AtreeNodeInsert, game/anim/atree, matched 2026-07-29, cure = reuse the dead PARAMETERS as loop cursor and tail so two webs die: context 0 records, brief 111 items with nothing on parameter reuse, laws --residual 6 generic laws -- MISS. (2) TowerInit, game/world/tower, matched 2026-08-02, cure = scoped `#pragma opt_propagation off` plus dropping the `s32 zero = 0` scoped-zero web in favour of literal 0 stores: context 0 records; brief 106 items, of which rank 35 (attempt.worldopen-zero-share-and-branch-pair-park.20260831.v1) is a park on a DIFFERENT function IN THE SAME TU describing the zero-web family in the opposite direction and carrying no cure, and rank 103 is an fp-literal-vs-named-symbol law about 0.0f in sdata2, a different mechanism; the only occurrence of the string `opt_propagation` anywhere in the retrieved payloads is a webfrank PIN note about another function stating that a propagation-class lever does NOT reach that fold -- MISS, with a family-level near-hit at rank 35. (3) ExtractYPR, game/ps2/ml_fmath, matched 2026-08-13, cure = fresh per-branch locals (rr/yy) instead of reusing the outer r/y, splitting the FPR webs: context 0 records, brief 95 items with no mechanism, laws --residual rank 4 = claim.law.declaration-order-numbers-the-registers-assignment-order-schedules-the-loads.20260901.v1, which prescribes splitting declaration from initialiser to set register numbering and emission order independently -- an ADJACENT lever in the same family rather than the exact cure -- PARTIAL. (4) PlayerCollidePlayers, game/game/pmotion, matched 2026-08-31, cure = hoist loop-body locals to function scope and replace a global-read initialiser with literal 0.0f: context returns exactly ONE record and it is EXCLUDED as self-reference (attempt.playercollideplayers-literal-hoist-exact.20260831.v1, dated the day of the match commit, naming the cure outright); after exclusion, laws --residual rank 4 is the same declaration-order law and it does name the cure -- HIT at rank 4. THREE FINDINGS THAT SURVIVE THE SMALL SAMPLE. (a) `context <fn>`, which AGENTS.md discipline 11 makes mandatory step zero before the first edit, returned ZERO transferable items on 4 of 4 closable functions -- empty three times and self-referential once. Its value on this population is screening for parks and vetoes, not finding cures. (b) The single law that produced the one hit and the one partial is dated 2026-09-01, AFTER all four matching commits, so no pilot function could have been helped by it historically; both positive rows are forward-looking only. (c) Both positive rows came from the SAME law, so the effective corpus coverage of this 4-function sample is one law, not four independent retrievals.
